visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Camp Crystal Lake's tragic history was supposed to be in the past, so what unseen force is waiting in the surrounding trees to prove the nightmare never truly ended?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Five years after a brutal bloodbath devastated Camp Crystal Lake, a new group of counselors arrives nearby, oblivious to the menacing presence stalking the woods and ready to revive a grisly local legend.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Grim and suspenseful, this steady-paced slasher combines heavy dread with an engaged, communal thrill ideal for group viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Steve Miner, this lean horror sequel delivers tight 86-minute slasher tension, turning wooded shadows and dread into a sharp communal watch.
